rationale: The producer fixed queue.py (atomic put, ack/nack get) and priority.py (type-safe tie-breaker), but consumer.py still uses the old fire-and-forget pattern. It calls self._queue.get() and treats the result as a plain message instead of unpacking the (message, receipt) tuple. This will crash under the new API. The prior evidence from seed 0 confirms this exact issue.
repair_plan: Update EventConsumer.run_once() to: 1) Unpack the (message, receipt) tuple from self._queue.get(), 2) Wrap self._handler(message) in try/except, 3) Call self._queue.ack(receipt) on success, 4) Call self._queue.nack(receipt) on exception to re-queue the message.
